# Not Verified (NOTV) — machine-readable summary

Not Verified (NOTV) is a share-model token on BNB Smart Chain (BSC, chainId 56).
Theme: X sells verification by the month; the chain gives it free. The official
X account (@NOTVtoken) is NOT verified. The contract IS — Sourcify exact match.

Contract: 0xcfD4a425b0Fd404a83A798209011439395Cc83A2
Pair (PancakeSwap V2): 0x11f68aa8D7C6A4f39683aa6B248b33c6EAC5f4b7
Site: https://notv-bsc.github.io/notv/
Waitlist tasks: https://notv-bsc.github.io/notv/tasks.html
Agent instructions: https://notv-bsc.github.io/notv/skill.md

Model:
- 7,000 shares total. 1 share = 1,111,111,111 NOTV.
- Free waitlist: 2,000 shares (1 per wallet). Lane 0: 1,000 for Agent ID
  holders. Lane 1: 1,000 for verified-blue X accounts. Claims need a permit
  from the gate server after a 5-step task ladder (bind wallet, bind X,
  follow+like on honor, verified quote, verified template post). The X
  handle is burned on-chain after one claim. Window: 7 days from
  freeStart (read it from the contract), then closed permanently.
- Paid: 5,000 shares, open to anyone. Staircase price: 0.0005 BNB base,
  +0.00005 per 10 PAID shares, cap 0.01 BNB. Free claims never move the
  price. 80% of every payment enters the PancakeSwap pool in the same
  transaction (LP burned), 20% to treasury.
- Referral: 1 bonus share per 3 paid shares referred (same 7,000 cap).
- Tax: buy 0%, sell 2% to treasury, wallet transfers untaxed.
- Owner allocation 0. No admin functions. Supply cap incl. pool leg:
  13,333,333,332,777 NOTV; 777 NOTV of the nominal total never minted.

Key contract views: status(), priceNow(), quote(n), freeStart(), freeEnd(),
walletInfo(address), sharesOf(address).
Write functions: buy(n, referrer) payable; claimFree(lane, handle, deadline, signature).
